title: Stop refuses unproven clauses in a live outside lane session, not only in unit tests
body:
Why: outside rerun 1115i on KRN 9aa2dc9 (after t-6fga7v5): both merged lanes still print `proof: clauses 0/N, red-first 0` (npm plain merged 46824a4 at .krn/runs/clause-proof/npm-1115i.log:461 clauses 0/4; py bug merged bc25be7 at .krn/runs/clause-proof/py-1115i.log:598 clauses 0/4), and stop refusals stay low; the one 5/5 lane did not merge. So in a real outside lane session the Stop clause arm does not refuse although the shared reader counts 0 proven.
Outcome: in a real outside lane session Stop refuses while the proof line would print clauses < N; find the gap between the unit tests of t-6fga7v5 and the live path (arm off for the contract? task body/clauses not visible to the hook in the session env (KRN_TASK / KRN_TASK_BODY)? hook not installed in the lane worktree settings? different base?) and close it.
Files: src/hook/stop.ts, src/cli/lane-run/*, src/brain/clause-proof or acceptance-clauses, tests.
Proof: a regression test that drives the lane-run path (session env + hook as it is wired for an outside repo) with the 1115i capture and is red before the fix; an outside npm rerun shows clauses N/N on every merged lane.
